items.title: Separate local wake-trigger validation from gateway wire delivery
acceptance: A decision with explicit price conditions is validated with its wake triggers before local-only fields are removed.
The gateway wire payload omits wake_triggers without reapplying local scheduler validation to the stripped payload.
A pending outbox with valid wake triggers reaches delivery and cannot starve all later cognition.
Detached operator-worker failures are visible through profile status rather than masked by a successful launcher.
evidence: 2026-07-31 live incident: valid NOTHING decisions at 06:05, 09:06, and 12:11 UTC remained in outbox because prepare_intent_for_delivery removed wake_triggers before validate_intent required them.
2026-07-31 deterministic reproduction: explicit above/below change_condition with matching triggers raised wake_triggers_missing_for_change_condition only during delivery projection.
2026-07-31 fix: validate the complete local decision before projecting glitch.intent.v2, persist direct-worker-status.json, and expose that status through /topstep_status.
2026-07-31 regression suite: explicit trigger parity, missing trigger rejection, real pending-outbox delivery path, and detached-worker status visibility.
